excerpts: [Article – NY Times Clay allows employees to sell shares at a $5b valuation.![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61702af2e3966e09c4101538/69a1f1f3a080096c6cf4cbfa_company-ads-v0.avif)](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/01/28/business/dealbook/clay-start-up-tender-offers.html?unlocked_article_code=1.H1A.LBNX.YbS98P3kIG8Q&smid=url-share) [Get a demo](https://www.clay.com/demo) [Sign up](https://app.clay.com/signup?source=nav) [All changelogs](https://www.clay.com/changelog) / [Product Roundup Week of September 21, 2026](https://www.clay.com/changelog/product-roundup-week-of-september-21-2026) September 28, 2026 Product Roundup Week of September 21, 2026 Clay Ads A set of improvements to Clay Ads makes ad audiences easier to manage at scale. Send **company lists** to LinkedIn for targeting, in addition to people-based audiences. **Pause** and **edit** recurring Ad Syncs instead of rebuilding them from scratch. Review **Sync history** in-product to see what ran, when, and what happened. Filter the **Ads** home page by provider and see export destinations more clearly. Find migrated legacy audience-backed syncs in the **Ad Syncs** tab with a "Legacy ad sync" prefix; recurring syncs keep running. Together these make recurring ad programs easier to run and audit. [Learn more →](https://www.clay.com/ads) IP Access Restrictions Admins can now restrict the incoming IP addresses that workspace members connect from, in a few clicks. Open **Workspace Settings** and go to the **Security** subsection. In the **IP access restriction** card, define the IP addresses allowed to access the workspace. Apply the same restriction to incoming browser requests and to API/MCP requests. This gives security teams a simple way to keep workspace access inside approved networks.

citations.title: Product Roundup Week of October 5, 2026
excerpts: October 12, 2026
Redesigned Clay home page The Clay home page has a refreshed design, with your **Workflows** and a **chat composer** right where you land.

Audiences sources & exports Sources and exports for Audiences data now live together in the **All people** and **All companies** views, and there's a new, recommended way to export Audiences data through Workflows.
More accurate Ads match rate reporting Clay Ads now reports audience sizes and match rates the same way each ad platform does, so the numbers in Clay line up with what you see on the platform.

basis.reasoning: The official article gives October 12 as its publication date and directly describes the homepage redesign, consolidated Audiences sources/exports and platform-aligned Ads reporting.

citations.title: Product Roundup Week of September 28, 2026
excerpts: October 5, 2026
Credit budgets now extend to Workflows, so admins can cap what automated runs spend.
You can now re-run many workflow runs in a single action, straight from the **runs dashboard**.
Workspace admins can now add their verified company email domain so teammates can join the workspace on their own, with no invite needed.
Clay Ads commands are now available in the stable **Clay CLI**, with a bundled skill so coding agents can manage Ads alongside the rest of your GTM work.
Redesigned Audiences record details
